// diagnostic

E0112

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

What

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

Why

Jet checks each use so a call cannot receive or render the wrong type

Fix

Use a value of the expected type, or convert it before passing or interpolating it

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0112: Tests/UI/BrowserBidi/native_bidi_bad_method_arguments_stop_in_sema.stderr.

Error [jet.ValueTypeMismatch]: `subscribe` wants String (text) for argument 1, but this is Int (a whole number)
  --> Tests/UI/BrowserBidi/native_bidi_bad_method_arguments_stop_in_sema.jet:17:23
    |
 17 |     session.subscribe(1) ?? return
    |                       ^
 Why: Every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: Put the value in text with interpolation: "{x}"
